name: Test research agent
description: Deterministic smoke-test agent. Waits a few seconds while reporting progress, then writes a Markdown report and a JSON result for the supplied topic. Can be told to fail on purpose. Uses only the Python standard library and makes no API calls.

topic.description: Research topic to include in the report.

seconds.description: How many seconds to simulate work. Defaults to 3.

fail.description: If true, the agent fails on purpose with a nonzero exit code. Defaults to false.
